title: Historical Atlas API Workbench
features: Developer documentation workbench with in-memory location CRUD request simulator, role/CSRF gates, request ID validation, coordinate validation and generated-point preview; environment docs exposure examples, content-free local audit lines, module-boundary explorer and database/operations references.
limits: Static frontend presentation of a Java/Spring Boot specification, not a Java backend implementation. Example endpoint payloads are illustrative because the linked location contract was not supplied. No database, Keycloak, OpenAPI generation, container, Maven build, secrets or network calls. Data and audit examples are memory-only; real server validation is not claimed.
